correctness.rationale: The paper’s regular planar matrix presentation provides unique four-way unit-square completion and exact rectangular counts |X_[0,m−1]×[0,n−1]|=s d^(m+n−2), uniform masses for occurring rectangles. A monotone staircase restriction is bijective with its enclosing rectangle: start with an L-shaped boundary completion, then reverse successive HV/VH corner swaps using the unique-fourth-corner rule. Every concatenated path P_v+jv from 0 to Nv contains |a|+|b| times N steps and so supports exactly s d^{N(|a|+|b|)} equiprobable patterns. The clopen partition on P_v attains both lower entropies; covering arbitrary fixed windows by a growing rectangle bounds both topological and canonical-measure entropies from above at the same rate. Applies to negative and zero coordinates, all nonzero integer v, with identity case v=0. Independently enumerated binary additive-square 4×4 patterns and all 20 staircase paths, verifying 128 patterns and bijective restrictions; finite test is not the universal theorem.

originality.rationale: Best of knowledge PASS: Bondarenko–Grigorchuk–Vdovina (2026) already establishes four-way extension, counts and canonical invariant uniform-rectangle measure for d-regular shifts; these essential premises are properly attributed. Their described zero-entropy full Z²-action and trace/conjugacy statements do not explicitly give simultaneous full-space rank-one entropies or common maximizing-measure assertion; the staircase identification bridges the gap. Johnson–Kass–Madden study line projection entropy, which is not the entropy of the complete homeomorphism σ^v. A broader algebraic Z²-action formula could still imply the result and is a residual priority risk.
residual_risks: An alternative formulation in pre-2026 commuting-square, algebraic-action or expansive-direction entropy literature could imply the same ℓ¹ norm.
Four-way unique completion must be part of the actual extendable matrix presentation; arbitrary d-regular labelings outside that equivalence are not covered.

value.rationale: An exact universal directional entropy norm for a natural structured zero-area-entropy class resolves an important distinction between single-line observations and full-space rank-one dynamics. The theorem additionally constructs one natural measure maximizing every integer direction, not just separate maximizing measures; the all-vector classification is nontrivial and reusable.
